description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelCloseButton class, which extends SugarWidgetField and provides a method displayList to generate an HTML close button for subpanels in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM user interface.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelCloseButton
classes.description: A widget class that renders a close button for subpanels in the CRM interface.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates an HTML anchor element that acts as a close button for a subpanel, with behavior depending on the module context and layout definition.
